known.title: Gate: module ceilings fail in board.py and codex.py

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Gate. This change increases src/forge/board.py from 1,197 to 1,202 lines and src/forge/codex.py from 1,191 to 1,203 lines. tests/test_rules.py:63–65 counts newline bytes and asserts that no module exceeds 1,200 lines. Both changed modules therefore fail test_5_forge_stays_small, preventing the required test gate from passing.
findings.follow_up: New finding on lines unchanged since the previous review.
findings.title: Gate: module ceilings fail in board.py and codex.py

why: The board and forge next show 'Worker running' for an item whose worker process or session is gone and whose lock is missing or stale, so a coordinator waits for ever
